key_terms.أَكْوَابٌ: Plural of cup or goblet, specifically large drinking vessels
key_terms.مَوْضُوعَةٌ: Set down, placed, or positioned within reach

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'goblets set' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of 'Kawthar' (abundance) as a tangible, sensory reward for the faithful, contrasting the spiritual thirst of the world with the eternal satisfaction of Paradise. The placement of the cups signifies ease and accessibility, reflecting the divine generosity where rewards are bestowed without effort or toil. This imagery serves as a metaphor for the purity of the soul's reward, distinct from the impurity of worldly pleasures.
